label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations involving food and an undisclosed gathering, possibly the day 1 eighteen-hundred great-hall appointment with the innkeeper. Reports place baker, freight, innkeeper and neighbour together at the bakery, with builder carrying bread. The stated bridge or port change is unconfirmed; the actual purpose of the preparations is not established. Secretary has assisted with scheduling but is not shown to know the concealed purpose.
